Frenkel, “A Monetary Approach to the Exchange Rate: Doctrinal Aspects and Empirical Evidence,” in Jan Herin, Assar Lindbeck, and Johan Myhrman, eds, Flexible Exchange Rates and Stabilization Policy (Boulder, CO: Westview Press, 1977), pp. 68~92。70 年代以后的数据并不支持货币分析法，对此请参阅 Radiger Dornbusch, "Exchange Rate Economics: Where Do We Stand?" Brookings Papers on Economic Activity 1:1980, pp. 143~185。

[20] 参见 Richard C. Marston, "Real Exchange Rates and Productivity Growth in the United States and Japan," in Steven W. Arnalt and J. David Richardson, Real-Financial Linkages Among Open Economies (Cambridge, MA: MIT press, 1987), pp. 71~96。及 McKinsey Global Institute, Manufacturing Productivity (Washington, D.C.: McKinsey & Co., 1993)。

[21] 图 15-6 选自 José De Gregorio, Alberto Giovannini, 和 Holger C. Wolf, "International Evidence on tradables and Nontradables Inflation," European Economic Review 38 (June 1994), pp. 1225~1244。进一步的证据参见 Patrick K. Asea and Enrique G. Mendoza, "The Balassa-Samuelson Model: A General-Equilibrium Appraisal," Review of International Economics 2 (October 1994), pp. 244~267。

[22] 我们可以不用考查外汇市场上的名义回报率差异，因为（如第 13 章所示）对任何给定的投资者来说，名义回报率差异等于实际回报率差异。对货币市场而言，名义利率是持有无息的现金而放弃的真实回报率。

[23] 在第 7 章对国际借贷的两期分析中，我们假设所有国家面临相同的世界真实利率，在该分析中，相对购买力平价一定成立，因为每一期只有一种消费品。

参考文献

Gustav Cassel, Post-War Monetary Stabilization. New York: Columbia University Press, 1928. 应用 the purchasing power parity theory of exchange rates in analyzing the monetary problems that followed World War I.

Rudiger Dornbusch, "Purchasing Power Parity," in The New Palgrave Dictionary of Money & Finance, Vol. 3. New York: Stockton Press, 1992, pp. 236~224. Examines the role of the purchasing power parity theory in international macroeconomics.

Rudiger Dornbusch. "The Theory of Flexible Exchange Rate Regimes and Macroeconomic Policy," in Jan Herin, Assar Lindbeck, and Johan Myhrman, eds, Flexible Exchange Rates and Stabilization Policy. Boulder, CO: Westview Press, 1977, pp. 123~143. Develops a long-run model of exchange rates incorporation traded and nontraded goods and services.

Charles Engel and Jeffrey Frankel, "Why Money Announcements Move Interest Rates: An Answer from the Foreign Exchange Market," in Sixth West Coast Academic / Federal Reserve Economic Research Seminar (Economic Review Conference Supplement). San Francisco: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, 1983, pp. 1~26. Studies the link between Fed money announcements, interest rates, and the exchange rate.

Kenneth A. Froot and Kenneth Rogoff, "Perspectives on PPP and Long-Run Real Exchange Rates," in Gene M. Grossman and Kenneth Rogoff, eds, Handbook of International Economics, Vol. 3. Amsterdam: North-Holland Publishing Company, 1995. Up-to-date critical survey of theory and empirical work.
